import openpyxl, os
out = os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(out)
ws = wb['OUPUT']
rows = [
    (4, 3, 'CARS-14', 'HUNDAY', 'KOR'),
    (5, 4, 'CARS-15', 'BMW', 'GR'),
    (6, 5, 'CARS-16', 'FIA', 'IT'),
]
for r, item, brand, typ, origin in rows:
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=item)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=brand)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=3, value=typ)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=4, value=origin)
wb.save(out)
print('done')
